description.zh: 查询的结束时间，单位：秒。如果不设置该参数，结束时间为当前的查询时间。
description.en: The end of the time range to query. This value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds. If you do not specify this parameter, the current time is used as the end time.

description.zh:
WAF实例ID。

> 您可以通过调用[DescribeInstance](~~433756~~)接口查看当前WAF实例ID。
description.en:
The ID of the Web Application Firewall (WAF) instance.

> Call the [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) operation to query the ID of the WAF instance.

description.zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

- **cn-hangzhou**：表示中国内地。

- **ap-southeast-1**：表示非中国内地。
description.en:
The region where the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.
The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group.

description.zh:
防护对象命中的规则类型。默认不设置该参数，表示显示全部规则。

- **blacklist**: 表示命中IP黑名单。

- **custom**：表示命中自定义规则。

- **antiscan**: 表示命中扫描防护规则。

- **cc_system**:  表示命中CC防护规则。

- **region_block**: 表示区域封禁。
description.en:
The type of rule that was triggered. If you do not specify this parameter, data for all rule types is returned.

- **blacklist**: The IP address blacklist.

- **custom**: A custom rule.

- **antiscan**: A scan protection rule.

- **cc\_system**: An HTTP flood protection rule.

- **region\_block**: The Location Blacklist feature.

description.zh: 查询的开始时间，单位：秒。
description.en: The beginning of the time range to query. This value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds.

title.zh: 查看命中防护规则的Top 10 防护对象

example.unifiedCli: aliyun waf-openapi describe-rule-hits-top-resource --start-timestamp 1665331200 --end-timestamp 1665386340 --rule-type blacklist --instance-id waf_cdnsdf30000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-manager-resource-group-id rg-acfm000q --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun waf-openapi DescribeRuleHitsTopResource --region cn-hangzhou --ResourceManagerResourceGroupId 'rg-acfm000q' --StartTimestamp 1665331200 --InstanceId waf_cdnsdf30000 --EndTimestamp 1665386340 --RuleType blacklist --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
